checks.tests: 20/20 PASS (55.2s), message-filters + existing replies + structure messaging, desktop/mobile, one worker

evidence.unit: Correspondent grouping by role/identity, same-name coaches disambiguated, stable dates/order, invalid date last, query intersection, no input mutation.
evidence.mocked_ui: Native select, keyboard, search + correspondent + date, no extra GET, drafts retained, missing correspondent after refresh, failure vs empty, malformed data, contrast >=4.5 and no horizontal overflow.
evidence.integrated: Real local athlete A/B messages + persisted coach reply. Coach filters A and sees its history; account B does not receive A messages even with recipientName query and cannot reply to A. Existing affiliation consent, both initiators, message repetition and network-error regressions also pass.
evidence.visual: Two cropped screenshots inspected on fake data; Playwright local, not MCP; no private records or tokens in assets.

limits: Manual refresh, no subject metadata filter, pagination, attachment or realtime notification added.
Selections are in memory, not URL/localStorage; full reload resets them.
Historical messages without coachId are not silently merged with identified same-name coaches.
No remote RLS/Supabase/Netlify validation, new service or deployment. No external email/SMS, payments or Premium activation.
Codex private usage counters unavailable; no quota/cost guarantee.
